source_context_review: Exact clause is conditional on diagonal authorization. Verify official device status, its diagonal-movement applicability and actual entry instruction from source evidence. A later phase change alone cannot establish noncompliance; the instruction may allow a pedestrian already crossing to continue. Preserve the NRS 484B.290 exception as unresolved until its own applicability evidence exists. Ordinary crosswalk permission is insufficient.
